subject: Mutual Action Plan: Elmbridge deployment mode & region decision
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Nguyen <sara@elmbridgelabs.com>, Raj Patel <raj@elmbridgelabs.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff: deployment mode & region decision

Hi Sara / Raj,

Thanks again for the time earlier. As discussed, the next step to get Elmbridge across the finish line is a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that ties the evaluation milestones to the contractual close. I attached a draft MAP worksheet (elmbridge_map_v3.xlsx) with proposed milestones and owners. High level ask from us: choose preferred deployment mode (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) and confirm primary region for go‑live (we recommended US‑East for latency to your main customer base).

Suggested evaluation plan (2–3 week cadence):
- Week 0: Field kickoff & access (ST credentials, sample payloads)
- Week 1: Performance baseline (p99 latency, throughput at 50 RPS) on Hosted vs Dedicated variant
- Week 2: Security checklist & SOC2 evidence review; Private deployment feasibility (if regulatory constraints)
- Week 3: Canary/rollout plan and Go/No‑Go decision + contract signatures

Open questions we flagged in the sheet: data residency constraints, acceptable SLOs, and whether you need a private VPC deployment for PHI workflows. If you confirm region/mode preference we’ll lock in test harnesses and spin up the appropriate infra for benchmarking.

Next steps: could you and Raj reply with preferred mode and any procurement lead we should loop in? I’ll update the MAP and shoot over a refined timeline + DocuSign link for the commercial term sheet.

Attachments: elmbridge_map_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet, 48KB)

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0193
From: Sara Nguyen <sara@elmbridgelabs.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj@elmbridgelabs.com>, procurement@elmbridgelabs.com
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: deployment mode & region decision

Thanks Connor — good summary. A couple quick clarifications before we commit to a mode:

1) Data residency: we have two product lines; Elmbridge Core can live in US, but Elmbridge Clinical must remain in the EU for specific customers. We need to understand if Redwood can support split deployments or geo‑fencing.
2) Security evidence: procurement wants SOC2 Type II artifacts and a network architecture diagram for Private deployments. Can you share?
3) Timeline: 3 weeks is great, but legal needs a week for review after we sign the MAP. Is that feasible?

On mode preference: our product team leans toward Dedicated for predictable latency, but if split EU residency is expensive we may prefer Hosted for US traffic and Private for the Clinical subset. Can your evaluation plan include a short Host vs Dedicated benchmark plus a Private feasibility call?

Thanks — looping procurement to start paperwork.

—Sara
Sara Nguyen
Director of Platform Engineering | Elmbridge Labs
sara@elmbridgelabs.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 08:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: deployment mode & region decision (internal notes)

Connor / team — internal quick note to prepare the MAP response for Elmbridge:

- Hosted vs Dedicated: we should target a short A/B run using the same model variant and input corpus. Dedicated (reserved GPU pool) will almost always win for p99 latency at scale due to isolated capacity and pinned KV cache, but Hosted is faster to start. We can quantify the delta with a 24h steady‑state run at 50–100 RPS.
- Private feasibility: Private (VPC or on‑prem) requires a short architecture review — I reviewed their architecture doc and the biggest lift is KMS integration and egress control. If they need EU residency for Clinical, recommend Private in EU‑region + Dedicated in US for Core.
- Eval plan additions: include tokenized cost projection per 10k users, and a quick quantization test for cost parity.

Proposed owners:
- Redwood infra: Karthik (benchmarks), Jordan (canary/ops runbook)
- Redwood sales/ops: Connor (commercial), Grace (legal/contract coordination)

I’ll prepare a one‑page tech summary and SOC2 packet pointer for Connor to send.

-Karthik
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Nguyen <sara@elmbridgelabs.com>, Raj Patel <raj@elmbridgelabs.com>
Cc: procurement@elmbridgelabs.com, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Updated MAP + proposed benchmark window (attached)

Sara / Raj — thanks for the quick feedback. I attached an updated MAP (elmbridge_map_v3.xlsx) with the following changes per Karthik's notes:
- Added parallel benchmark tracks: Hosted vs Dedicated (US‑East) over a 48h steady window; Private feasibility call scheduled if Clinical EU residency is required.
- Cost projections and quantization test added to Week 1 deliverables.
- SOC2 evidence pointer attached (SOC2‑evidence‑2026.pdf) and a redwood_private_architecture.drawio.png for a sample Private layout.

Can we lock the benchmark window for May 25–27? That gives our infra team time to stage Dedicated instances and test harnesses. If that works, I’ll send a short DocuSign with the MAP acceptance and an annex listing the exact test data required.

Attachments: elmbridge_map_v3.xlsx (updated), SOC2-evidence-2026.pdf (doc, 320KB), redwood_private_architecture.drawio.png (diagram, 75KB)

Next steps (proposed):
1) Elmbridge confirms preferred primary mode (if undecided, we run Hosted + Dedicated comparison).
2) Elmbridge confirms primary region for test (we recommend us‑east).
3) Procurement signs MAP acknowledgment (DocuSign link will follow).

Connor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0193

From: Sara Nguyen <sara@elmbridgelabs.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj@elmbridgelabs.com>, procurement@elmbridgelabs.com
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 16:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Updated MAP + proposed benchmark window

Connor — confirmed: Elmbridge will proceed with the Hosted vs Dedicated benchmark (primary test region: US‑East). If results favor Dedicated we will convert that into a Dedicated commitment for Core and open a Private conversation for Clinical (EU) in parallel.

Procurement (cc) — please expect a MAP acknowledgment from Connor; legal will need the SOC2 packet (received) and the Private architecture diagram for initial review. Raj / procurement: can you please confirm a legal review window (we expect ~5–7 business days after MAP signing).

We are good to run May 25–27. Please send the DocuSign and any pre‑test access instructions by EOD Monday so our infra team can open ports and share sample payloads.

Thanks — Sara
